items.question: What is the maximum number of occupants in the cabin?
items.explanation: Maximum number of occupants in cabin shall not exceed 19.

items.question: Maximum gross weight for towing or taxi is?
items.explanation: Maximum gross weight for towing or taxi is 8350 kg.
references: RFM Sec 1: Weight and CG Limitations (p.1-2)

items.question: What is the maximum gross weight for CAT B take-off/landing?
items.explanation: Maximum gross weight for CAT B take-off/landing is 8300 kg.
references: RFM Sec 1: Weight and CG Limitations (p.1-2)

items.question: Minimum flight/rotor running gross weight?
items.explanation: Minimum flight/rotor running gross weight is 5400 kg.
references: RFM Sec 1: Weight and CG Limitations (p.1-3)

items.question: What is the minimum flight weight when Hd is less than −5000 ft?
items.explanation: Minimum flight weight for Hd less than −5000 ft is 6000 kg.
references: RFM Sec 1: Weight and CG Limitations (p.1-3)

items.question: Minimum airspeed for flight under IFR (Vmini) is?
items.explanation: Vmini for IFR is 50 KIAS.

items.question: Maximum airspeed for IFR approach is?
items.explanation: Maximum airspeed for IFR approach is 150 KIAS.

items.question: Maximum airspeed with one autopilot failed is?
items.explanation: With one AP failed, maximum airspeed is 110 KIAS.

items.question: Maximum airspeed for operation of windscreen wipers?
items.explanation: Windscreen wipers maximum operating airspeed is 140 KIAS.

items.question: Minimum airspeed in autorotation is?
items.explanation: Minimum airspeed in autorotation is 60 KIAS.

items.question: Maximum landing gear operating airspeed (Vlo) is?
items.explanation: Vlo is 150 KIAS or Vne if less.

items.question: Maximum landing gear extended airspeed (Vle) is?
items.explanation: Vle is 150 KIAS or Vne if less.

items.question: Maximum airspeed with transmission torque (TQ) above 100%?
items.explanation: With TQ above 100% the maximum airspeed is 90 KIAS.

items.question: When must pitot heating be selected to AUTO or ON?
items.explanation: Pitot heating must be AUTO or ON at indicated OAT of +4 °C or less.

items.question: Maximum wind speed for rotor starting and stopping?
items.explanation: Maximum wind speed for rotor starting/stopping is 50 knots.

items.question: On paved surfaces, maximum taxi speed is?
items.explanation: On paved surfaces, maximum taxi speed is 40 knots.

items.question: On paved surfaces, maximum speed for emergency landing is?
items.explanation: On paved surfaces, maximum speed for emergency landing is 60 knots.

items.question: On prepared grass surfaces, maximum taxi speed is?
items.explanation: On prepared grass, maximum taxi speed is 20 knots (above 10 knots the nose wheel must be locked fore and aft).

items.question: On prepared grass surfaces, maximum speed for emergency landing is?
items.explanation: On prepared grass, maximum emergency landing speed is 20 knots.

items.question: Maximum airspeed for opening/closing cabin doors?
items.explanation: Maximum airspeed for opening/closing cabin doors is 50 KIAS.
references: RFM Sec 1: Cabin Door Open Limitations (p.1-8)

items.question: Maximum lateral windspeed for opening/closing cabin doors?
items.explanation: Maximum lateral windspeed for opening/closing cabin doors is 20 knots.
references: RFM Sec 1: Cabin Door Open Limitations (p.1-8)

items.question: With doors locked open, maximum wind/ground/airspeed is?
items.explanation: With one or both cabin doors locked open, maximum wind/ground/airspeed is 50 KIAS.
references: RFM Sec 1: Cabin Door Open Limitations (p.1-8)

items.question: If Kit Stop Passenger Door P/N 8G5212F00211 is fitted: max airspeed for opening doors or with doors locked open?
items.explanation: With the Kit Stop Passenger Door fitted, maximum airspeed for opening or with doors locked open is 80 KIAS.
references: RFM Sec 1: Cabin Door Open Limitations (p.1-8)

items.question: If Kit Stop Passenger Door is fitted: maximum airspeed for closing doors?
items.explanation: With the Kit Stop Passenger Door fitted, maximum airspeed for closing doors is 60 KIAS.
references: RFM Sec 1: Cabin Door Open Limitations (p.1-8)

items.question: Is flight into known icing conditions permitted?
options: Yes, if the appropriate Icing Kit is installed and functioning
Yes, if pitot heat is ON
items.explanation: Flight into known icing is prohibited unless the appropriate Icing Kit is installed and functioning.

items.question: Flight into freezing rain or freezing fog is?
options: Permitted if de-icing kit is installed
items.explanation: Flight into freezing rain and freezing fog is prohibited.

items.question: Maximum slope angle for takeoff/landing (nose up, nose down, left/right wing low)?
items.explanation: Sloped operations are limited to 10 deg in all directions.

items.question: Aerobatic manoeuvres are?
items.explanation: Aerobatic manoeuvres are prohibited.

items.question: During autorotation, may ENG MODE select switches be moved from FLIGHT to IDLE?
options: Yes, if both engines are at idle
items.explanation: During autorotation, ENG MODE select switches must NOT be retarded from FLIGHT to IDLE except in an emergency.

items.question: APU starter duty cycle is?
options: 20 s between attempts; after 3 aborted starts wait 20 min
10 s between attempts; after 3 aborted starts wait 15 min
30 s between attempts; after 3 aborted starts wait 30 min
60 s between attempts; after 3 aborted starts wait 60 min
items.explanation: APU: 20 seconds delay between attempts; after 3 aborted starts, wait 20 minutes.

items.question: At which OAT must the HEATER system NOT be selected to APU?
items.explanation: The HEATER system must not be selected to APU when OAT is above 20 °C.

items.question: Engine fuel pressure: minimum normal operation is?
items.explanation: Engine fuel pressure minimum for normal operation is 0.3 bar.

items.question: Engine fuel pressure normal operation range is?
items.explanation: Engine fuel pressure normal range is 0.3 to 1.8 bar.

items.question: Engine fuel pressure maximum is?
items.explanation: Engine fuel pressure maximum is 1.8 bar.

items.question: Engine fuel pressure cautionary range is?
items.explanation: Engine fuel pressure cautionary range is 0.0 to 0.2 bar.

items.question: APU fuel pressure minimum normal operation is?
items.explanation: APU fuel pressure minimum for normal operation is 0.7 bar.

items.question: APU fuel pressure normal operation range is?
items.explanation: APU fuel pressure normal range is 0.7 to 1.8 bar.

items.question: APU fuel pressure maximum is?
items.explanation: APU fuel pressure maximum is 1.8 bar.

items.question: Total usable fuel capacity is?
items.explanation: Total usable fuel capacity is 1320 litres.

items.question: Total unusable fuel is?
items.explanation: Total unusable fuel is 24 litres (12 litres per tank).

items.question: Hovering in crosswinds/sideways flight with sustained roll angles > +/- 15 deg is prohibited when indicated fuel in either tank is less than?
items.explanation: Hovering in crosswinds or sideways flight with sustained roll > +/- 15 deg is prohibited when indicated fuel in either tank is < 50 kg.

items.question: Cross feeding (tank with pump OFF): maximum transferable quantity is?
items.explanation: Maximum cross feeding (tank with pump off) is 283 kg.

items.question: Rotor brake: maximum rotor speed (NR) for brake application?
items.explanation: Maximum NR for rotor brake application is 40%.

items.question: Rotor brake: maximum system pressure with lever in BRAKE position?
items.explanation: Maximum pressure when lever is in BRAKE is 62.5 bar.

items.question: Rotor brake: minimum pressure to keep lever in BRAKE position?
items.explanation: Minimum pressure for lever in BRAKE position is 40 bar.

items.question: Engine oil pressure: minimum for ground idle (< 1 min) is?
items.explanation: Engine oil pressure minimum for ground idle for less than 1 minute is 1.4 bar.

items.question: Engine oil pressure: minimum for normal operation is?
items.explanation: Engine oil pressure minimum for normal operation is 2.2 bar.

items.question: Engine oil temperature transient (time-limited) maximum is?
items.explanation: Engine oil temperature transient (15 minutes) maximum is 149 C.

items.question: MGB oil pressure normal operation range is?
items.explanation: MGB oil pressure normal operation range is 3.1 to 6.0 bar.

items.question: Rotor speed (NR) power-ON continuous operation range (AEO/OEI) is?
items.explanation: Power-ON continuous operation range is 100-104% NR.
